title: KUP v1 common definitions
description: Kriya UI Protocol v1 (P-24). Shared definitions for the envelope, availability sections and errors. Unknown properties are allowed everywhere a Kriya record is carried: the contract never silently discards recorded detail.

Availability.description: Availability of an optional panel section (P-24). A host treats any value outside this list as unknown, never as success.

Section.description: An optional panel section: availability first; data only when recorded (D-5: nothing is reconstructed).

provenance.description: Which persisted record the data comes from (e.g. runs.run_events).

reason.description: Why the section is not recorded/unreadable/excluded/unsupported. PROVISIONAL free text in v1 (owner instruction 2026-10-04): database-state reasons will be typed once the D-4 topic is decided.

data.description: Present and non-null only when availability is recorded.

ErrorCode.description: Typed KUP error codes (06 Phase B). A host may receive other codes from a newer Kriya and must show them literally.

code.description: Usually one of ErrorCode; kept open so a newer Kriya can add codes without breaking an older host (P-27).

database_state.description: PROVISIONAL: the store state that produced STORE_BUSY/READ_ONLY_UNAVAILABLE (e.g. the A1 case id). Not final until the D-4 topic closes.

state_directory.description: Absolute path, as resolved by Kriya (SEC-009 / state_paths).

trace_database.description: Absolute path of the trace database read.

kind.description: PROVISIONAL (owner instruction 2026-10-04): the read-consistency model. Expected values include sqlite_transaction_snapshot; the final vocabulary depends on the D-4 decision (A1 measured that WAL stores need a write-denying boundary or a sidecar exception to be readable).

live_stream.description: Always false in M1 (manual refresh, P-32).

Envelope.description: Every KUP response. On error, data is null and source/consistency may be null (resolution may have failed before they were known).

observed_at.description: UTC observation time set by Kriya (ISO 8601).

data.description: Operation payload, or null on error.

StoredText.description: A stored TEXT column in recorded form: the raw string (JSON text stays JSON text), or null when NULL in the row.
